title: Easy Access to Baselines
author: Neal Mitchell
content: A new feature introduced in fastProject 4.7.3 are baselines are now easily accessible within the Inspector. Just click on the baseline you want to see and it will pop-up on the Gantt Chart. Each baseline includes the total pull-in/slip days. You can select the baseline just before the last update, just after the last Wigglechart was run (after an update and pull-in session) or after a previous Wigglechart was run.
